note: Real output of the app engine (v0.5.0) on its seed hands, one solver run each. Frequencies shift a little between runs because solves stop at a time budget. Amounts are in dollars at the hand stakes; divide by bigBlindDollars for big blinds. Grades come from the app grading function, which reproduces the app-reported grade for the original play.
